name: My Crush's Fishy Incident
source:
Short visual novel about boy who is in love in a girl. He is asked by her to take care of her fish during her absence in order to earn her love. Decide what to do, read immersive dialogues and have fun! Can you reach all three unique endings?

[Edited from [url=https://mikulus.itch.io/fish-tank]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
关于男孩爱上女孩的短篇视觉小说。她请他在她不在期间照顾她的鱼，以赢得她的爱。决定要做什么，阅读身临其境的对话并享受乐趣！你能达到全部三个独特的结局吗？

[编辑自[url=https://mikulus.itch.io/fish-tank]itch.io[/url]]
